items.title: The Egg Stand That Stopped Bringing People to the Gate
items.pitch: Help a hen keeper afford a lawful egg-selling permit. A later cooperative may keep the sales going while moving every pickup away from the familiar garden gate.

present_hook.what_you_notice: A household file contains a cancelled egg-selling application and a costed pickup plan.

clues.line: The flock in {year} was real, but the remaining lawful startup costs were unaffordable.

window.notes: A and B are actual permitted hen keepers with existing suitable flocks and legal premises. The small gift covers A evidenced startup shortfall. Baseline has no A egg-selling business. No eggs, animal health, customers or home-business permission are generated by the gift.

interventions.how_it_looks: Give the keeper a week’s wages toward the actual licensing and handling shortfall.

ripples.headline: A Hen Keeper Opens an Approved Egg Pickup Stand
ripples.body: The qualified permitted stand opens at the actual home gate. Only real inspected eligible stock is offered under its actual sale terms.

ripples.headline: Local Producers Establish a Funded Egg Cooperative
ripples.body: Actual consenting producers adopt the lawful organization and its real handling, payment and delivery terms.

ripples.headline: A Cooperative Moves Pickups Away from a Home Gate
ripples.body: The funded lawful collection plan takes effect and the old stand closes after its orders are settled. Actual sales continue only through completed cooperative transactions.

fails.headline: The Gift Does Not Open an Egg Stand
fails.body: The money remains real, but no qualifying permitted stand opens. No production or sales are invented.

present_day.best: If the chain and arrangement persist in {now}, the old gate has no operating sales stand and the actual cooperative notice identifies its lawful collection point and fees.
present_day.worst: Without completed stages, retain actual stock, permissions and business rights; a gift creates no harvest, customers or profit.
present_day.twist: {A} retains only the actual cooperative sales entitlement while paying the agreed handling fees and losing the direct pickups that brought customers to the gate.

npc_lines_after.line: The eggs still leave the yard. The customers do not come into it anymore.

new_rules_needed: Bind distinct actual living residents at intervention; require present year at least intervention+25. Select each elapsed year uniformly within its interval using a stable seed/scenario/role-IDs/intervention-year/step/timing key; each step uses a separate independently keyed uniform success roll. Later steps require the preceding committed step and all current prerequisites. Recheck age, survival, residence, consent, authority, title, skills and resources. Invalid eligibility or roll failure stops descendants, retaining earlier changes and ordinary simulation. fails.chance complements the first valid step roll, never a separate event; invalid eligibility has no failure bulletin. Reserve affected funds, residents, assets and sites and commit effects atomically once after ordinary mortality. Resolve concurrent conflicts in stable scenario-ID order without rerolls or partial effects. Do not repeat direct intervention effects. Present descriptions and dialogue require their recorded changes and still-valid current facts; show only realized prefixes otherwise. No new people, relationships, buildings or ownership are implied.

Add egg stand as a business kind and egg cooperative as an organization type. open_egg_stand requires A title or permission, existing lawful flock and actual suitable eligible egg stock, completed permits, safe qualified handling, real funds and affordable actual customer orders. Create one A-owned stand and record real costs, stock and transactions; no automatic yield or wealth bonus.

form_egg_cooperative requires actual willing eligible producers including A and B, lawful governance, real capital, suitable permitted available handling premises, competent staff and independently viable contracts. Record shares, exact stock ownership, fees, inspection and payment obligations without creating members, eggs or a guaranteed market.

end_home_egg_pickups requires the same cooperative active, a real funded permitted collection location and transport, actual consenting affected customers and producers, A informed agreement and lawful settlement of every current stand order. Close only the registered home stand, preserve actual cooperative shares and pay only evidenced handling fees on completed transactions. Gate A dialogue on step 3, survival, remembered real gate customers and current off-site collection. The gate dialogue additionally requires A still has the actual active lawful flock and current A-origin egg shipments from that yard, not merely passive cooperative shares.
items.era_notes: Permits, animal keeping, egg handling, labeling and cooperative law follow each actual event year.
items.why_fun: A small home enterprise can grow into a system that keeps the work and loses the greetings.

items.title: The Public Program That Lost Its Personal Sign-Off
items.pitch: Introduce two residents with a feasible public-access television proposal. A long-running program may later surrender one founder’s personal sign-off when an actual editorial agreement changes.

present_hook.what_you_notice: A community-media file contains two unconnected applications for the same available public-access opportunity.

clues.line: The actual access arrangement in {year} had space for a qualified proposal, but these applicants had never met.

window.notes: A and B are strangers relative to each other and actual qualified consenting prospective producers. Bind an existing lawful public-access service with real capacity, operator permissions and viable budget. Baseline has no joint program. No television network, audience, political endorsement or broadcasting right is created by the introduction.

interventions.how_it_looks: Make the welcomed introduction over the actual public-access proposal.

ripples.headline: Two Producers Launch an Approved Public-Access Program
ripples.body: The funded permitted program completes its actual first production under the signed access terms.

ripples.headline: A Local Program Renews Its Actual Editorial Agreement
ripples.body: The qualified current parties complete the real funded renewal with documented editorial authority and an agreed personal sign-off.

ripples.headline: A Renewed Program Adopts Its Agreed Shared Sign-Off
ripples.body: The freely accepted lawful editorial amendment takes effect. The founder’s former exclusive closing segment ends under its actual terms.

fails.headline: An Introduction Does Not Produce a Program
fails.body: The meeting occurs, but no qualifying funded permitted production completes. No audience or editorial right is invented.

present_day.best: If the chain and program persist in {now}, its actual current closing segment uses the shared sign-off and its contract no longer grants {A} the former exclusive closing slot.
present_day.worst: Without an actual amendment, preserve the real program, editorial authority and agreements. No access service implies guaranteed airtime or compelled speech.
present_day.twist: The program gains the actually agreed shared closing format, while {A} gives up the documented exclusive sign-off and its personal airtime.

npc_lines_after.line: It is still a place for people to speak. I am learning to stop before the end.

Add public-access program as a media-service entity type. launch_access_program requires an existing authorized actual access operator, valid slot agreement, independently qualified consenting producers, real equipment and funds, clear content rights and completed compliant production. Record actual scope, schedule and costs, not a new station or audience.

renew_access_program requires the same program survives, actual available capacity, operator approval, valid funded renewal and informed parties. Record the exact editorial roles and A genuinely agreed exclusive sign-off; no permanent right, guaranteed political influence or speech by unbound residents.

replace_personal_signoff requires actual surviving program, A still holds the real closing right, a freely negotiated lawful amendment with all affected rights settled and an actual funded completed production using the new shared format. End only that agreed exclusive segment, respecting operator obligations and lawful editorial independence. Gate A dialogue on step 3, survival, current actual loss of the former slot and remembered founding role.
items.era_notes: Public-access availability, equipment, recording, rights and editorial arrangements must exist in each actual event year.
items.why_fun: The past can give someone a public voice and eventually change which part of it belongs to that person.

items.title: The Find Beneath the Unbuilt House
items.pitch: Help a qualified volunteer afford a real archaeological survey contribution. A documented site may later receive protection and an exhibit, at the cost of a landowner’s actual planned building footprint.

present_hook.what_you_notice: A land file contains a cancelled survey quote and the unchanged history’s unbuilt house plan beside a recorded surface find.

clues.line: The non-funerary objects recorded in {year} are not enough by themselves to change legal building rights.

window.notes: A is a genuinely trained supervised volunteer; B the actual parcel owner with a real viable house proposal; C an independently qualified authorized archaeologist. Baseline includes an actual non-funerary cultural surface find, lawful survey possibility and no protected designation or exhibit. Require existing title, permissions and applicable heritage law; no remains, new land or invented ancient people.

interventions.how_it_looks: Give the volunteer a week’s wages toward the actual authorized survey shortfall.

ripples.headline: A Qualified Survey Documents an Actual Cultural Site
ripples.body: The authorized team records only genuine existing finds and supported context. The survey alone grants no public access or title.

ripples.headline: A Site Receives Its Lawfully Agreed Protection
ripples.body: The competent process records the actual protected footprint and settled owner obligations under the valid instrument.

ripples.headline: A Documented Site Gains a Funded Local Exhibit
ripples.body: The authorized collection completes the real exhibit in suitable existing premises. It displays only lawfully held objects and supported interpretation.

fails.headline: The Contribution Does Not Complete the Survey
fails.body: The gift remains real, but no qualifying completed survey exists. A surface object does not automatically stop construction or establish a history.

present_day.best: If the chain and protection persist in {now}, the actual exhibit records the documented site and the parcel map excludes the identified protected footprint from the original house proposal.
present_day.worst: Without valid survey, protection or exhibit, retain actual title and building rights. No artifact or restriction is created to fit the story.
present_day.twist: The town gains the actual documented collection, while {B} loses the legally settled ability to use the particular protected footprint for the genuine house plan.

npc_lines_after.line: They can tell me what stood here before. I know what I was going to put here next.

survey_cultural_site requires real existing non-funerary cultural material, owner informed permission, qualified C current authority, A actual supervised role, lawful methods and affordable funding. Record observed provenance, custody and supported context only; create no remains, cultural affiliation or story without evidence.

record_cultural_site_protection requires the surveyed site still exists, actual competent authority or valid voluntary instrument, lawful notice, informed parties and settled title, compensation if applicable and appeal rights. Require B still holds the real viable affected house proposal and a legally identified incompatible footprint. Record exact restrictions and obligations; no automatic confiscation, invented payment or blanket building ban.

open_cultural_site_exhibit requires actual lawfully held documented objects, clear relevant ownership and consent, qualified interpretation, competent collection authority, safe accessible existing available premises, funded installation and maintenance. Add archaeological exhibit as a collection/venue type, not a new business or building. Keep unsupported claims out of text. Gate B dialogue on step 3, survival, actual remembered proposal and current affected footprint.
items.era_notes: Survey methods, heritage powers, title rules, collections and interpretation follow the actual event years.
items.why_fun: A changed town can gain a longer past by losing a piece of the future one resident had already drawn.

items.title: The Kitchen Paid for by a Life You Ended
items.pitch: Kill a bank owner to force an actual estate into motion. An heir may eventually fund a community kitchen, but the meals will never undo the death that made the money available early.

present_hook.what_you_notice: A civic file contains an unfunded kitchen proposal and an estate plan that never released its assets during the useful window.

clues.line: The owner in {year} was alive, and nobody had a right to spend the estate early.

window.notes: A is B actual parent and B the adult child. Bind bank to A actual business, B as the genuinely eligible heir under the valid estate documents and C as an actual qualified prospective kitchen operator. Baseline has A alive and no released estate or funded kitchen. Require genuine assets, title and future lawful authority; the scenario does not make murder socially acceptable or erase the loss.

interventions.how_it_looks: End the owner’s life in the intervention year; the death is permanent and recorded as murdered.

ripples.headline: An Estate Transfers Only Its Lawful Remaining Assets
ripples.body: After the recorded death and actual estate process, the eligible heir receives only the real remaining entitlement. Debts, claims and other heirs’ rights are settled.

ripples.headline: An Heir Completes the Lawful Closure of an Inherited Bank
ripples.body: The actual authorized owner completes the approved solvent wind-down. Depositors, workers and creditors retain their full lawful rights.

ripples.headline: A Community Kitchen Opens on Its Actual Funded Terms
ripples.body: The authorized parties complete the lawful inspected kitchen on a genuinely available site. Its operating budget and qualified staff are real.

fails.headline: The Death Releases No Qualifying Inheritance
fails.body: The killing remains an irreversible recorded death, but no qualifying estate transfer completes. No money, bank ownership or kitchen is created as compensation.

present_day.best: If the chain and kitchen persist in {now}, Main Street has the actual operating community kitchen and the inherited bank business is closed. The death record still names the person who did not live to see it.
present_day.worst: If any estate or funding stage fails, keep the actual death and unresolved obligations. No unrealized public benefit cancels the killing.
present_day.twist: People may gain actual meals and work through the funded kitchen, while {B} has permanently lost a parent and the town has lost that resident and the original bank business.

npc_lines_after.line: The kitchen opened. That does not give me my parent back.

Override living-A checks after intervention: A must remain dead from the direct kill, and no ripple repeats death or restores A. Apply ordinary investigation, evidence and legal consequences independently, including any effect on inheritance eligibility. No killer exemption, hidden culprit identity or automatic forgiveness.

inherit requires actual recorded death, valid estate authority, B lawful eligibility after any forfeiture rules, real assets after debts, taxes, claims and all other heirs’ rights. Transfer only B actual entitlement once, including bank control only where the actual instrument and banking authority permit it. No fabricated wealth or waived criminal consequences.

close_shop requires B still legally controls the inherited bank and regulators authorize an actually funded orderly wind-down. Fully settle or lawfully transfer deposit liabilities, staff rights, creditors, title and contracts before closing; use only actual remaining net proceeds in B assets. No lost deposits, new wealth bonus or automatic land ownership.

The build effect requires B actual freely chosen affordable funding from remaining lawful assets, C current independent qualifications, an actual suitable legally available Main Street site, title or owner permission, permits, safe completed construction, real staffing and viable ongoing operating budget. Add community kitchen as a public-service venue type. Record actual meals and jobs only when performed, not guaranteed participation. Gate B dialogue on step 3, survival, actual parentage and remembered loss; A has no after-line.
items.era_notes: Estate, banking, kitchen and investigation rules follow actual years. The death is described without gore and never framed as a reversible payment.
items.why_fun: The changed present can contain something useful that the player still has no clean way to feel good about.
